legalEntitlement: Loi 1.334 art 11: the schooling duty is met in the ordinary setting, or failing that specially
Special education is set by the child's own particular needs, in specialised services
Each such child gets a regular evaluation of competences, needs and the measures in their path
The commission medico-pedagogique does that evaluation, and the child and parents are heard
On disagreement parents ask the director to reverse his decision (Loi 1.334 art 25)

sources.label: Loi n° 1.334 du 12 juillet 2007 sur l'éducation (Monaco), arts. 11 and 25 and the individual-evaluation article — Journal de Monaco no. 7817. The Act's full text, recorded on this entry as not retrieved, serves from journaldemonaco.gouv.mc at HTTP 200

legalEntitlement: The instrument is 05-071 Chapter 101, the Maine Unified Special Education Regulation
Every school administrative unit taking federal or State funds must comply with IDEA
That duty runs to children from birth to twenty-two, under 20-A MRSA s.7006
Speech or language impairment is a named category, covering stuttering and language impairment
It qualifies only where it adversely affects the child's educational performance
